analyst_view.overall: Osasuna (16th, 12 pts) host bottom side Málaga (20th, 5 pts) at El Sadar on Sunday evening in a game both badly need. Osasuna miss goalkeeper Aitor Fernández and Bretones (in the numbers); Budimir is back from Croatia duty, Oroz and Herrando are available but short of rhythm, and winger Del Castillo trained with the group on Friday but has played only 34 minutes this season and Arrasate is avoiding risks with him. Málaga have Aznou suspended and miss Lobete, Rafita and Ochoa (mostly in the numbers), while Puga and Juan Cruz are back in training. Moncayola is one booking from a ban, and no referee had been named in the pages I read.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.8 goals and already give Málaga a small boost for Bretones being out. Osasuna have scored only 12 in 12, Del Castillo is unlikely to be risked from the start, and a nervous relegation game tends to be cautious; since he is back in group training I trim only a little, to about 2.7.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.3 corners, with both sides' recent corner counts already counted. Osasuna lean on crosses from Rubén García and Moi Gómez for Budimir, which brings corners, and Málaga will need to attack; it balances out, so I stay at 10.3.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.6 cards; they add Osasuna's recent cards (19 in six) and take some off Málaga's quieter run, but make no adjustment for the stakes. A relegation fight against a bottom side that must take risks tends to be scrappy, so a small lean up to about 4.8; no referee named yet.

shots.text: The numbers say 30.6 shots and already add a lot for both sides' recent shooting and how much each concedes (+11% each). A nervy game and Del Castillo's limited role point a little lower, but Budimir being fit and Málaga needing to attack point the other way, so I stay at 30.6.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.6 shots on target. Budimir is fit after the break, as the numbers assume, and Málaga's recent accuracy (33 on target in six) is already counted; no clear reason to move it, so 9.6.
